owner_directive: 弱趋势慢慢兑现，已经走出大趋势的仓位尽量继续跟均线
approved_bundle: Owner authorized autonomous exploration. V11 showed that a uniform release size still truncates audit super-trends. V12 causally discounts a release when at least +8 ATR had already been observed before that release.

frozen_entry.contract: Exact V5 K1/K2 morphology and one-signal-per-live-regime ledger.

frozen_execution.gap_stop_fill: bar open when it gaps beyond the active stop
frozen_execution.state_update_timing: streak, earned strength and SMA trail calculated at close t become actionable on t+1

adaptive_harvest.multiplier_timing: freeze the applicable release fraction when the qualifying close occurs, using earned slots already observed by that close
adaptive_harvest.release_fill: next bar open; if the open gaps through the active stop, stop has priority
adaptive_harvest.remainder: unchanged SMA60 minus direction times one current ATR runner

selection.rank: Among arms meeting every gate, maximize robust half-year net bp and then use the smaller strong-trend release multiplier. If none pass, retain the baseline and report failure.
selection.audit_rule: Audit only the development-selected multiplier when every gate passes.
